component.name: Vulkan Audio Visualizer
component.summary: Real-time Vulkan and MilkDrop system-audio visualizer

description.p: Vulkan Audio Visualizer is a GPU-accelerated desktop audio visualizer for Linux built in Rust with wgpu (Vulkan) and FLTK. It captures your live system audio output directly through PipeWire / PulseAudio monitor sources so visuals react smoothly to music players, browsers, or any desktop audio stream.

ul.li: 52 built-in reactive WGSL shaders covering Chaos, Fractals, Tunnels, Kaleidoscopes, Auroras, Particles, and Waveforms
Native MilkDrop (.milk) engine featuring an EEL2 expression VM, HLSL-to-GLSL shader translation, and user texture support
Real-time 2048-point Hann-windowed FFT across 64 logarithmic bands with adaptive beat detection
Full-canvas display with an auto-fading info overlay, searchable preset browser (Ctrl+P), fullscreen mode (F11), and custom shader hot-reloading (F5)
Sandboxed folder import via XDG Desktop Portal for external MilkDrop preset collections

description.p: Added native MilkDrop (.milk) EEL2 and HLSL-to-GLSL engine, full-canvas interface with auto-fading info overlay, searchable preset browser, portal-compatible MilkDrop folder import, custom application icon, and Flatpak packaging.
